dedupe_keys.name: national cycle network uk walk wheel cycle trust

description: The National Cycle Network layer from Walk Wheel Cycle Trust, formerly Sustrans, the custodian of the UK National Cycle Network, depicts more than 12,000 miles of signed paths and routes for walking, cycling and wheeling across the United Kingdom. The public view layer contains over 35,000 polyline features with route attributes and is updated every Sunday from edits by regional staff and volunteers. Coverage is the United Kingdom, including Northern Ireland, which was captured in WGS 84 and reprojected. Access: free as an ArcGIS feature service and a WFS service under the Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: the trust cannot guarantee the data to be free of error, the view layer only draws at city scale and above, and the public version is in Web Mercator, not the native British National Grid. It supports active mobility network topology, route choice and accessibility analysis and the exposure of cycle routes to floods or closures, and complements the EuroVelo network, the Propensity to Cycle Tool and CycleStreets catalogued here.
name: National Cycle Network (UK), Walk Wheel Cycle Trust
